mdx.scenario: A document decision turns on where Markdown ends and evaluated JSX or a mapped component begins.
An MDX import, export, expression, component provider, or compile/runtime seam controls the result.
Removing all JSX and component expressions leaves a heading, list, link, or reference question intact.
Element grammar or transform configuration is independent of the MDX document seam.
A rendered embedded component has a React Hook, state, effect, or render question.
An imported typed component or TSX expression has a TypeScript checking question.
An expression turns only on general JavaScript evaluation semantics.
An Astro collection, route, or island directive controls an MDX document's framework placement.

astro.scenario: An .astro component decision depends on the frontmatter and template execution split.
An island client directive determines hydration or the server/client execution boundary.
A content collection schema, file route, project convention, or Astro integration controls the result.
A React component inside an island has a state, Hook, effect, or render question after hydration.
An MDX document question turns on its Markdown-to-component seam.
A library-independent JSX syntax or transform question appears inside Astro.
A TypeScript type-checking question appears in Astro frontmatter or an imported component.
A generic Node host, package, process, or runtime question is outside Astro's framework boundary.
A Vite-internals, Starlight, styling, accessibility, or deployment decision is requested.
